City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 21, 2024 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.

S3.

S2.

S2.

S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS – NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the June 26, 2024, Special Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Biennial review of the San Dieguito Water District Conflict of Interest Code and Filers. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Receive and file the report
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08D Conflict of Interest Filers
8E.
Notice of Completion of Public Water Improvements at 1967 N Vulcan Avenue by Vulcan Encinitas, LLC. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. The action involves acceptance of public water improvements and filing a Notice of Completion. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Notice of Completion.
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08E Notice of Completion 1967 N Vulcan
8F.
Emergency Repairs to a Blow Off for the 36-inch Transmission Main on Rancho Santa Fe Road (CW25G). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is statutory exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under 15269 of CEQA Guidelines as an "Emergency Project" where urgency is required to implement a project that reduce threats to health and property. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
Authorize the emergency repair to a blow off for the 36-inch Transmission Main on Rancho Santa Fe Road.
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08F Emergency Repair
8G.
Quitclaim of Water Easement to Raintree Encinitas LLC for the property located at 550 Encinitas Blvd (APN: 258-131-03-00). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. 258-131-03-00)"; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Public Water Easement.
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08G 550 Encinitas Blvd Quitclaim
8H.
Quitclaim of Water Easement to Santa Fe Regal, LLC for property located at 921 Regal Road (APN: 258-251-25-00). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
258-251-25-00)"; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Public Water Easement.
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08H 921 Regal Road Quitclaim
8I.
Reject bid for Annual Asphalt Repair and Services Contract. Environmental Considerations: The proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301 (c) of the CEQA Guidelines. This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion on the existing use. This annual Asphalt repair contract is a water maintenance project and therefore, meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Water Operations Manager Gonzalez
1) Reject the sole bid received from the August 2, 2024, bid opening for the Annual Asphalt Repair and Services contract; and 2) Authorize staff to re-advertise and rebid the Annual Asphalt Repair and Services contract.
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08I Re-authorizing Asphalt RFB
8J.
Authorization to purchase Water Meters and Endpoints from Badger Meter Inc. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board of Directors is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Section 15301(b). This section exempts projects characterized as minor alterations to public facilities, involving negligible or no expansion on the existing use. This contract is a water maintenance project and therefore, meets the criteria for this exemption. Contact Person: Water Operations Manager Gonzalez
1) Authorize the District to purchase water meters and endpoints (registers) from Badger Meter, to improve operational efficiency, and ensure accurate billing; and 2) Approve Resolution No. 2024-14 titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget."
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S08J Agenda Report Authorization to Purchase Water Meters and Endpoints from Badger Meter Inc.
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.
San Diego County Water Authority Upfront Prepayment of Fixed Charges Program. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Authorize the General Manager to enter the San Dieguito Water District into an agreement with the San Diego County Water Authority (SDCWA) to prepay the Fixed Charges for Calendar Year 2025 and receive a four percent discount; 2) Approve Resolution No. 2024-13 titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Operating Budget".
2024-08-21 SDWD Item S10A SDCWA Upfront Prepayment of Fixed Charges

Receive the oral report.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
